faqs.q: What is a Continental mud booster hose used for?
faqs.a: A mud booster hose boosts circulating mud volume in deep and horizontal-well drilling. This Continental ContiTech hose has a mud-resistant NBR liner and high-tensile steel-cable plies, with a bonded coupling, for standard-service mud lines.

faqs.q: What inner diameters does the Continental mud booster hose come in?
faqs.a: The Continental mud booster hose is listed from 3" to 5" inner diameter. Custom sizes outside this range can be quoted, and the lead time extends accordingly. State the inner diameter and the host port type on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Continental mud booster hose have?
faqs.a: The Continental mud booster hose is rated 3,000 psi working pressure (WP) and 7,500 psi minimum burst pressure (MBP). WP is the continuous service rating, MBP is 2.5 times WP, and hydrotest pressure is 1.5 times WP.

faqs.q: What temperature range does the Continental mud booster hose cover?
faqs.a: The Continental mud booster hose is rated -30°C to +82°C for standard service. Sour service (H2S and CO2) and high-temperature variants exist for most product families, so state the wellbore conditions on the RFQ for an engineering review.

faqs.q: What are the liner and reinforcement of the Continental mud booster hose?
faqs.a: The liner is mud-resistant NBR and the reinforcement is high-tensile steel cable plies. The coupling is bonded to the hose body, so end fittings are not field-replaceable.

faqs.q: What standard does the Continental mud booster hose meet?
faqs.a: The listing gives the standard as API 7K-equivalent (mud booster service), which is not the same as API 7K Grade D rotary hose. Each assembly ships with a test certificate referencing the applicable API standard, and third-party witness is available if you ask on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What end fittings does the Continental mud booster hose use?
faqs.a: The coupling is factory-bonded with the hose body and not field-replaceable, and the bonded geometry follows API 7K. Specify the host port type on the RFQ, typically NPT, hammer union or API ring joint.

faqs.q: What lengths are standard for the Continental mud booster hose?
faqs.a: Standard rig-floor assemblies of the Continental mud booster hose are 50 ft (15 m), 75 ft (23 m) and 100 ft (30 m), and lengths up to 250 ft (75 m) are available for offshore tensioner and compensator service. Specify the exact length and end fittings on the RFQ; the [oilfield hose guide](/blog/oilfield-hose-guide) explains how.

faqs.q: Where is the Continental mud booster hose used?
faqs.a: It is used in mud lines that boost circulating volume on deep and horizontal wells, connecting through the rig mud system. See [drilling hoses](/c/drilling-hoses) and the guide on [API 7K rotary and vibrator hose](/blog/api-7k-rotary-vibrator-hose).

faqs.q: How does the Continental mud booster hose differ from other drilling hoses?
faqs.a: The mud booster is rated 3,000 psi WP with a 3" to 5" bore, while the [rotary and vibrator hose, mud bonded](/p/rotary-vibrator-hose-mud-bonded) is the API 7K Grade D hose for standpipe and kelly hose service. Use the booster hose only for the mud booster duty.
